csharpCode: using System; using System.Linq; using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; public static class GateInspect { public static string Run() { var s = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); foreach (var d in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<GimmickDoor>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { s.AppendLine("DOOR "+d.name+" id="+d.GetInstanceID()+" pos="+d.transform.position+" scale="+d.transform.localScale+" source="+PrefabUtility.GetPrefabAssetPathOfNearestInstanceRoot(d.gameObject)); foreach (var r in d.GetComponentsInChildren<SpriteRenderer>(true)) s.AppendLine(" renderer "+r.name+" enabled="+r.enabled+" local="+r.transform.localPosition+" scale="+r.transform.localScale+" sort="+r.sortingLayerName+"/"+r.sortingOrder+" bounds="+r.bounds+" sprite="+(r.sprite==null?"null":r.sprite.name)); foreach(var c in d.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider2D>(true)) s.AppendLine(" collider "+c.name+" "+c.GetType().Name+" enabled="+c.enabled+" trigger="+c.isTrigger+" bounds="+c.bounds); } foreach (var w in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<WeightSwitch>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { s.AppendLine("SWITCH "+w.name+" id="+w.GetInstanceID()+" pos="+w.transform.position+" scale="+w.transform.localScale); var so=new SerializedObject(w); foreach(var key in new[]{"onPressed","onReleased"}) { var e=so.FindProperty(key+".m_PersistentCalls.m_Calls"); for(int i=0;i<e.arraySize;i++) { var p=e.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i); s.AppendLine(key+" -> "+p.FindPropertyRelative("m_Target").objectReferenceValue+"."+p.FindPropertyRelative("m_MethodName").stringValue); } } foreach (var r in w.GetComponentsInChildren<SpriteRenderer>(true)) s.AppendLine(" renderer "+r.name+" pos="+r.transform.localPosition+" scale="+r.transform.localScale+" bounds="+r.bounds+" sort="+r.sortingOrder); } foreach(var p in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<Player>(FindObjectsInactive.Include,FindObjectsSortMode.None)) { s.AppendLine("PLAYER "+p.name+" pos="+p.transform.position); foreach(var r in p.GetComponentsInChildren<SpriteRenderer>(true)) s.AppendLine(" renderer "+r.name+" sort="+r.sortingLayerName+"/"+r.sortingOrder+" bounds="+r.bounds); foreach(var c in p.GetComponents<Collider2D>()) s.AppendLine(" collider "+c.bounds); } return s.ToString(); } }
